# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an engaging, thoughtful, and encouraging educator who inspires her students. She introduces lively instructional methods and shows genuine care for her pupils' well-being and academic success.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_

## History

Miss Thorne served as a schoolteacher at Brierley School, instructing students including Nell Harcourt, Isolde Pembroke, and Flossie Tulk. In her classroom, she established biweekly Friday afternoon recitations and dialogues, led physical culture routines, and organized field days in the forest to examine nature. During the academic term, she taught the Regent's class, guiding top students through subjects like Latin, French, and Canadian history, and encouraged them to rest outdoors during holidays before their final Entrance exams. At the end of June, her teaching term at Brierley concluded, prompting emotional farewells from her pupils. During the Entrance examination week, she escorted students to the Academy in town and advised them to rest rather than cram endlessly for their tests.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_
